subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same simple red robot with matching body shape, head, and white eyes appears across all shots.

background_coherent.rationale: The gray studio, slanted floor line, dark block, and pale yellow circle persist with plausible reframing.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches a wide shot of the red robot standing in the gray studio.
Shows the same robot moving across the studio, though the view still reads mostly frontal rather than clearly side-on.
Closer angled framing of the same robot in the same studio; return-to-mark action is implied rather than strongly visible.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: Shots preserve distinct framing and subject placement without collapsing into copied compositions.

motion_continuity.rationale: Robot position and framing change plausibly across shots, with shot 1 indicating lateral movement.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks identity or scene consistency.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are not copies and preserve requested camera/framing variation.
